skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply advanced programming techniques for developing management information systems.
Develop skills in programming to develop management information systems.
Deploy smart systems for management and business operations.
Create classes and access their components in C++.
Understand and apply class inheritance in C++.
Understand and apply constructor functions in C++.
Understand and apply copy constructors in C++.
Understand and apply multiple level inheritance in C++.
Understand and apply virtual base classes in C++.
Work independently or actively participate in group activities.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of management information systems.
